pages.text: The disbelievers of Quraysh drove the Prophet ﷺ out of his town, Makkah, and he set out with his companion Abu Bakr as-Siddiq (may Allah be pleased with him).
The two of them took refuge in a cave in the mountain of Thawr, and they stayed there for three nights.
Abu Bakr was afraid for the Prophet ﷺ, and he said: “If one of them were to look down beneath his feet, he would see us.” (Sahih al-Bukhari 3653)

The Prophet ﷺ said to him: ﴿لَا تَحۡزَنۡ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَنَاۖ﴾ — interpretation of the meaning: 'Do not grieve; Allah is with us.' And Allah sent down tranquillity into the heart of His Prophet, and saved him from his enemy.
